description: Cs₄Na₂MgV₂O₈ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are two inequivalent Cs sites. In the first Cs site, Cs is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Cs-O bond distances ranging from 3.06-3.63 Å. In the second Cs site, Cs is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Cs-O bond distances ranging from 2.88-3.06 Å. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.64 Å. Mg is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.02 Å) and two longer (2.03 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. V is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.77-1.91 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two Cs, two equivalent Na, and one V atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to one Cs, two equivalent Na, one Mg, and one V atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Cs, one Na, one Mg, and one V atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to four Cs and one V atom.
